#en: The farm sits where the frontier thins out, half-swallowed by dust and silence, a place supply routes once skirted and then simply forgot. That is why the trail converges here: nobody bothered to sanitize the records, scrub the consoles, or pull the last map off the wall when the crops turned bad and the locals walked. Directive Coldfront holds the ground now, too professional for raiders, too temporary for settlers, guarding something they likely do not fully understand, just following coordinates and pay slips. Earlier, a stray dataslate in a lonely shack led to whispered testimony about armed escorts at miracle fields, and both pointed toward a pattern of hidden corridors and rerouted shipments that all bear the same careful, Scottish hand.
zh: 这座农场坐落在边境变稀薄之处，被尘土与沉默半吞，一个补给航线曾经绕行、随后干脆忘掉的地方。正因如此，线索才汇聚于此：当作物变坏、当地人离开时，没人费心去清理记录、擦净控制台，或把最后一张地图从墙上撕下来。如今据守这片地面的是"冷锋"指令组——对掠夺者来说太专业，对定居者来说太临时，守着一件他们大概并不完全理解的东西，只是遵照坐标与薪水行事。早先，一座孤独棚屋里散落的数板牵出了关于"奇迹农田"处武装护航的低语证词，两者都指向一种由隐藏走廊与改道货运构成的模式——全都带着同一只谨慎的、苏格兰式的手笔。

#en: Whoever left these route traces out here did it in a hurry, then came back later and tried to scrub them clean; you can see it in the broken timestamps, the gaps where jump data should be, the way official patrol logs suddenly get very neat around the same days. This is not just navigation history, it is a record of who knew she was bending the lanes and how close they came to catching her before somebody higher up decided it was safer to pretend none of it ever happened. Trouble is, secrets like that leak; an Aegis agent with too many questions vanishes to the fringe, smugglers start talking about "haunted corridors," and a dead LIST slate on a forgotten rock lines up just a little too well with convoy "malfunctions" no one wants on the books.
zh: 在外面留下这些航线痕迹的人，做得匆忙，之后又回来试图把它们擦干净；你能从破碎的时戳、本该有跃迁数据的空缺，以及官方巡逻日志在同样那几天突然变得极其整洁中看出来。这不只是导航史，而是一份记录：谁早知道她在掰弯航道、他们离抓住她有多近，然后某个上级决定假装这一切从没发生过更安全。麻烦在于，这种秘密会泄漏：一名问题问得太多的宙斯盾特工消失到了边境，走私者开始谈论"闹鬼的走廊"，而被遗忘岩石上一块死掉的独立盟数据板，与那些没人愿意记入账册的车队"故障"对得实在太巧了些。

#en: The old drop shelter sits exactly where smugglers and raiders like to vanish between radar sweeps, its hull half-swallowed by dust and forgotten report files. Inside, the air tastes of stale propellant and burned circuitry, the kind of place a nervous liaison would hole up to sort contraband routes in peace, far from officers with questions and clients with guns. Whatever he kept here was meant to be revisited, adjusted, expanded, but the scattered bottles and half-packed crates say he left in a hurry and never circled back. All you have so far is a dead courier's fractured nav slate and whispers that the same pilot's name haunts both that trail and this bunker, hinting that these corridors were the first threads in a much longer invisible line.
zh: 那座旧投放掩体恰好坐落在走私者与掠夺者喜欢在两次雷达扫描之间消失的地方，它的外壳被尘土与废弃报告文件半吞。里面，空气尝起来像陈旧推进剂与烧毁电路的味道，是那种紧张的联络人会躲进来、安静整理违禁航线的场所，远离有问题的军官与带枪的客户。他留在这里的东西本打算再来复查、调整、扩充，可散落的瓶子和半打包的箱子说明他走得匆忙，再没绕回来。目前为止，你只有一名死掉信使破碎的导航数据板，以及"同一个飞行员的名字同时萦绕在那条线索与这座掩体上"的低语——暗示这些走廊是一条远更漫长的隐形线上最初几根线。

#en: The AR-6086 Gunspire hangs in the dark like a loaded die someone forgot to roll, squatting over a patch of empty orbit no trade lane ever bothers to cross. Whatever ledger of routes and stresses Torque has been feeding his patterns into would have to be kept somewhere no auditor or shipyard clerk could stumble across it by accident, and a gunship turned silent warden fits the superstition perfectly. Every spacer who mentioned this hull gave a different version of what it guards and who it answers to, but the details always circle the same path: a ghost outpost, an off-the-books cache, a SysDef derelict whose altered patrols and scrubbed logs keep pointing back to the same mechanic and the same quiet string of near-failures no one wants written down.
zh: AR-6086 枪塔悬在黑暗中，像一枚被人忘记掷出的灌铅骰子，蹲守在一片没有任何贸易航道愿意穿过的空荡轨道上。无论"扭矩"一直在把自己的模式喂进哪本航线与应力的账册，那本账都必须放在任何审计员或船坞文书都不会碰巧撞见的地方，而一艘变成沉默看守的炮舰完美契合这种迷信。每一个提起这具船壳的太空劫匪，都对它守着什么、听命于谁有不同版本，可细节总是绕着同一条路：一座幽灵前哨、一处账外储藏点、一具星防队弃船——它被改动的巡逻与擦净的日志不断指回同一名机修工，以及那一串没人愿意写下来的安静险情。

#en: Out here, skimming the dark limb of an unnamed world, the noise drops away until only grav tides and reactor hum remain, and that is exactly the kind of silence she needs to write her own corrections into everyone else's maps. The relay sitting in this orbital blind spot has been sampling every ship that dares a shortcut, folding their mistakes and near-misses into a pattern only she understands, while the hired guns circling it think they are guarding nothing more than another piece of junk. Back in the capital the archivist whispered about erased warnings, and the first corrupted logs on that forgotten rock showed identical hands on the course corrections; every story since then has repeated her name with a little more fear and a little less blame.
zh: 在这里，贴着某颗无名世界的幽暗边缘掠过，噪声褪去，只剩引力潮与反应堆的嗡鸣，而这正是她需要的那种寂静——好把她自己的修正写进别人的星图里。坐镇这个轨道盲点的那座中继，一直在对每一艘胆敢抄近路的船进行采样，把它们的错误与险情折成一个只有她懂的模式，而绕着它转的雇佣枪手以为自己在守的不过是又一件废铁。在首都，档案员低声说起被抹除的警告，而被遗忘岩石上最初那些损坏日志显示，航向修正出自同一双手；此后每一个故事重复她的名字时，恐惧都多一分，责怪都少一分。

#en: The dead Deimos yard hangs crooked over the moonlet like a rusting confession, every torn hull plate and silent crane a reminder of who taught this place how to come apart. Only here could she twist the machinery she once served into a shelter, a weapon, and a blind spot in UC surveillance, feeding stolen relay fragments into old shipbreaker systems while rival hunters close in. The pattern of her flight has always curved back to scrap and secrecy, and this is the last patch of metal she can still call her own. From the support ship we pulled a corrupted trail of seized hardware; in the mine, we found proof that someone paid well to bury her name. No one said what they were really afraid of, only that if we kept following the cuts, we would find her.
zh: 那座死掉的火卫二场区歪斜地悬在小卫星上方，像一份生锈的忏悔，每一块被撕裂的船壳板与每一台沉默的吊臂都在提醒：是谁教会了这地方如何解体。只有在这里，她才能把她曾效力的机械扭成庇护所、武器，以及联殖监视里的一个盲点，在对手猎人逼近时把偷来的中继碎片喂进旧拆船系统。她飞行的模式总是弯回废料与隐秘，而这是她仍能称作自己的最后一块金属。从支援船上，我们拉出了一条被损坏的截获硬件轨迹；在矿场里，我们找到了有人花大价钱掩埋她名字的证据。没人说他们真正怕的是什么，只说如果我们继续顺着那些切口追下去，就会找到她。

#en: The moonside cargo relay sits in the dark between worlds, a forgotten joint in the freight skeleton where manifests go missing and sealed tanks change ownership without ever touching a customs screen. This is where people like the broker make their real living, shaving truth off the numbers for whoever pays best, and where the pattern of diverted water and ghost shipments can finally be seen without the noise of a busy port. Crack the paper-thin lies here and the routes Catalyst favors stop being rumor and start becoming coordinates. So far the trail runs from a broken dataslate on a dead rock to nervous haulers in Neon's back alleys, all whispering about tankers off the books and a hydrologist who treats trade lanes like veins to be rerouted at will.
zh: 那座卫星侧货运中继坐在世界之间的黑暗中，是货运骨架上被遗忘的一个关节：舱单在此失踪，密封储罐在此易主，却从不经过海关屏幕。这里正是像那位掮客这样的人真正谋生的地方——为出价最高者从数字上削去真相；也正是"被改道的水"与幽灵货运的模式终于能在没有繁忙港市噪声干扰下被看清的地方。在这里敲开那些纸一样薄的谎言，"催化剂"偏爱的航线就不再是传闻，而开始变成坐标。目前为止，线索从死寂岩石上一块损坏的数据板，延伸到霓虹城后巷里紧张的货船船员，他们都在低声议论账外的罐车，以及一名把贸易航道当成可随意改道的血管的水文学家。

#en: Out in the thin glow above the planet, the deep space recon grid still listens, a rusted halo of sensors no one bothered to decommission because no one bothered to remember it existed. This is where raw grav noise becomes pattern, where tiny shifts in a ship's course are recorded long before flight control decides what the official story should be. If someone has been cutting their own lanes through restricted sky, the proof will be in these forgotten echoes, split time stamps and mismatched vectors quietly archived and never reviewed. You have already chased ghost readings from an abandoned station and unearthed buried scans in an old bunker, each hinting at a lone navigator slipping past patrol grids along paths the public charts never acknowledged.
zh: 在行星上方那片稀薄辉光里，深空侦察网仍在聆听——一圈锈蚀的传感器光环，没人费心退役它，因为没人费心记得它存在。这里正是原始引力噪声变成模式的地方，是船只航向里微小的偏移在飞行控制决定官方故事该是什么样之前很久就被记录下来的地方。若有人在受限天空中切出自己的航道，证据就会在这些被遗忘的回声里：被拆分的时戳与对不上的向量，被悄悄归档、从不复核。你已经追过一座废弃星际站的幽灵读数，也在一座旧掩体里挖出过被埋的扫描数据，每一处都暗示一名孤独的领航员沿着公开星图从不承认的路径溜过巡逻网格。

#en: Down in The Well, the air hums with recycled water and secondhand stories, the kind of place where routes are bought in whispers and no one ever claims to be the source. If MacLeod has been moving dangerous cargo and people through the cracks of the Settled Systems, the records of who paid, who looked away, and which ports opened at the wrong hour will be anchored here, buried under layers of favors and deniable transactions. Every dockhand, broker, and drifter swears they only heard his name from someone else. So far, the trail runs from that first stray dataslate to anxious settlers on the fringe and a glowing farm that should have failed, each step tightening the circle around one man who understands supply lines better than any government auditor.
zh: 在深井区，空气因循环水和二手故事而嗡鸣，是那种航线靠低语买下、且从没人承认自己是来源的地方。如果麦克劳德一直在把危险货物与人送过定居星系的裂缝，那么"谁付了钱、谁转开了视线、哪些港口在错误的时刻开放"的记录就会锚定在这里，埋在层层人情与可否认交易之下。每个码头工、掮客与流浪者都发誓自己只是从别人那里听到他的名字。目前为止，线索从最初那块散落数据板，延伸到边境上焦虑的定居者与一座本该失败的发光农场，每一步都收紧着围绕一个人的圆圈——他比任何政府审计员都更懂供应链。

#en: New Homestead matters because this is where the sky has been bent into his argument. The old colony relies on clean approaches to keep its lifeline intact, and Vector has rewired those beacons into the spine of his final chart, forcing every inbound ship to ride the edge of his math. If he finishes here, the corrected routes he broadcasts will ripple through the wider network, rewriting more than this one world's sky and locking his lattice in before anyone can refute it. The trail to this point started with a buried dataslate on a forgotten rock, then a survivor's haunted testimony in this same settlement, and finally a corrupted relay hanging in quiet orbit, each step tightening the pattern around one navigator who never stopped adjusting the lanes.
zh: 新家园之所以要紧，是因为天空正是在这里被他掰成了自己的论点。这座旧殖民地仰赖干净的进近来维持其生命线完整，而"向量"已把那些信标重新接线，成了他最终星图的脊柱，迫使每一艘入港船只都沿着他数学的边缘飞行。若他在这里完工，他所广播的修正航线就会在更大的网络中扩散，改写的将不止这一颗世界的天空，并在任何人能反驳之前把他的网格锁死。通往这一步的线索始于一穷乡星上被埋的数据板，然后是这座定居点里一名幸存者被纠缠的证词，最后是一颗悬在安静轨道上损坏的中继；每一步都收紧着围绕一名从未停止调整航道的领航员的模式。

#en: In the husk of the depot, amid half-drained power cells and cargo that never found a buyer, the old routing spine still hums, feeding quiet instructions into the beacon grid every time a freighter passes nearby. This is where Vector tested his math against real ships and real lives, burying his work in the same forgotten infrastructure the Spire Skulls now strip for scrap and blood money. Cut this node and the pattern of his hand in the lanes will stand out at last, however he has tried to diffuse it through abandoned hardware and missing manifests. So far the trail has been a string of dead haulers, encrypted logs under a decommissioned base, and freight records that all point back to one vanished consultant who keeps rewriting the same few corridors.
zh: 在那座货运站的空壳里，在半耗尽的电池与从未找到买家的货物之间，旧的航线脊柱仍在嗡鸣，每当有货船经过附近，它就把安静的指令喂进信标网。这里正是"向量"拿真实船只与真实人命检验他那套数学的地方，他把自己的作品埋进同样被遗忘的基础设施——如今尖塔骷髅正把它们拆成废料与血钱。切断这个节点，他在航道中的手笔模式终于会凸显出来，无论他曾如何试图用废弃硬件与失踪舱单把它摊薄。目前为止，这条线索是一串死掉的货船、一座退役基地下加密的日志，以及指向同一名消失顾问的货运记录——他不断改写着同样那几条走廊。

#en: Out here the stories say he talks to his clients through dead hardware, riding along on forgotten relays and survey beacons nobody bothered to decommission. This lonely rig in high orbit fits the pattern too well to ignore, and the crew of the Riftclaw is not babysitting it for charity. If there is a signal that links his math to a real departure point, it will be hidden in whatever this platform has been quietly forwarding. So far the trail is all secondhand talk and half-sanitized records a corrupted slate on a backwater rock, a doctored manifest in a wandering freighter's hold, a war-era sim that does not quite agree with itself each rumor pointing to the same soft-voiced navigator who keeps turning blind spots in the net into private thoroughfares.
zh: 在这里，故事说他通过死掉的硬件与客户交谈，附着在被遗忘的中继与没人费心退役的勘探信标上。高轨道上这座孤零零的设备太契合这个模式，无法忽视，而"裂隙爪"的船员可不是在做慈善看护它。若说有哪个信号把他的数学与一个真实的出发地系在一起，它就会藏在这座平台一直在悄悄转发的任何东西里。目前为止，这条线索全是二手说辞与半清理过的记录：穷乡岩石上一块损坏的数据板、一艘漂游货船货舱里被做手脚的舱单、一段与自己都不太对得上的战时模拟——每一则传闻都指向同一名嗓音柔和、不断把网中盲点变成私人通途的领航员。

#en: Deimos has always been where things go to sit too long, from old hulls to unpaid invoices, and the scrapyard is where both finally start to blur together. Here, under frozen floodlights and half-stripped frames, manifests outlive the ships they belong to, and paper trails cling to rusted bulkheads long after GalBank pretends they were closed. If there is a record of who has been quietly redirecting assets and escorts, it will be buried under these retired keels, watched by contractors who know the value of a forgotten registry stamp. So far the trail is a mislaid slate in lonely orbit, freight that never matched its paperwork in crowded Gagarin bays, and a hand in Neon's shadows redrawing safe routes for those who paid in the right kind of desperation.
zh: 火卫二一直是东西放置太久的地方，从旧船壳到未付的账单，而废料场正是两者最终开始模糊在一起之处。在这里，在冻结的泛光灯与半剥光的框架下，舱单活得比它们所属的船只更久，纸面痕迹黏在锈蚀舱壁上，久久之后盖尔银行才假装它们已被结清。若说还有记录显示谁一直在悄悄改道资产与护航队，它就会埋在这些退役龙骨之下，由那些懂得一枚被遗忘登记章之价值的承包商看守。目前为止，线索是孤独轨道上一块放错位置的数据板、加加林星拥挤货舱里从未与文书对上的货物，以及霓虹城阴影中一只为那些付出"正确类型的绝望"的人重画安全航线的手。

#en: The abandoned relay bunker sits exactly where the patrol grid frays, a forgotten knot of concrete and antennae that once listened to every ship cutting through this slice of sky. Whatever those stolen scan logs recorded, they were taken here, under codes that still recognize UC clearance and still echo with the fugitive's passage through restricted airspace. If any record survived the purge orders, it will be buried in these darkened consoles, in the gaps between official routes and the paths a cautious engineer would carve for himself. The trail has been pulling you this way since that corrupted buoy in orbit, each rumor and registry error bending toward the same pattern of vanished hulls and one stubborn signature threaded through every quiet disaster.
zh: 那座废弃中继掩体恰好坐落在巡逻网格磨损之处，一团被遗忘的混凝土与天线结，曾经聆听每一艘切过这片天空的船。无论那些被盗的扫描日志记录了什么，它们都是在这里被取走的，所用的代码至今仍认得联殖权限，仍回响着那名逃犯穿越受限空域的经过。若说还有任何记录在清除令中存活，它就会埋在这些变暗的控制台里，埋在官方航线与一名谨慎工程师会为自己凿出的路径之间的空隙里。自从轨道上那枚损坏的浮标之后，这条线索就一直把你往这边拉，每一则传闻和每一处登记错误都弯向同一个模式：消失的船壳，以及一个穿在每一场安静灾难里的顽固签名。

#en: If his equations touched flesh and blood anywhere, it is here, in the star-station that quietly logs every grav-scarred pilot and every misjumped freighter under the language of medicine. The Clinic is where route experiments stop being theory and start leaving lesions on nervous systems, and its archives are thick with redacted scans and off-the-record consultations that someone like him would need to refine a corridor no one else can see. What began as a half-heard spacer tale in a remote rock, then a doctored cargo log on a wandering hauler, then an old war sim from a forgotten bunker has become a story retold in waiting rooms and freight bars a rumor of a soft-voiced navigator whose math keeps showing up wherever ships vanish without leaving wreckage.
zh: 如果说他的方程曾在任何地方触碰血肉，那就是这里——这座星际装置用医学的语言悄悄记录着每一名带着引力伤疤的飞行员和每一艘错跳的货船。星际诊所号正是航线实验不再是理论、而开始在神经系统上留下病灶的地方；它的档案里塞满了涂黑的扫描与不留记录的问诊——像他那样的人需要这些来打磨一条别人看不见的走廊。起初只是偏远岩石上半听来的太空劫匪故事，然后在某艘漂游货船上成了被做手脚的货运日志，再从一座被遗忘掩体里成了旧战时模拟——如今它已变成在候诊室与货运酒吧里被反复讲述的故事：一个嗓音柔和的领航员，只要船只消失而不留残骸，他的数学就会冒出来。

#en: The busted hulls and stripped frames in this yard are just the bones; the real story is in whatever data the scavvers were too scared or too stupid to wipe. If someone has been bending safe lanes around an unseen point, the first honest record of that curve will be in the navigation guts of ships that never made it back to port, and this is where their remains ended up. The Dust Backlot Boys are squatting here for a reason, clinging to a pile of rust and half-dead cores like it is a throne, arguing over scrap while something cleaner and quieter hums in the background. So far the trail holds a stray dataslate on a forgotten rock, gossip about vanished convoys, and a pattern of "malfunctioning" traffic that all seems to slip past Deimos before it disappears.
zh: 这座场区里破损的船壳与被剥光的框架只是骨头；真正的故事在那些拾荒者因为太害怕或太愚蠢而没抹掉的数据里。若有人一直在绕着一个看不见的点掰弯安全航道，那条曲线的第一份诚实记录就会存在于从未回港的船只的导航内脏里，而这里正是它们残骸最终落脚之处。尘埃后院帮蹲在这里是有原因的，抓着一堆锈铁与半死的核心像抓着王座，一边为废料争吵，一边有某个更干净、更安静的东西在背景里嗡鸣。目前为止，这条线索里有被遗忘岩石上一块散落数据板、关于失踪车队的闲话，以及一种"故障"交通模式——它们似乎都在消失之前先溜过火卫二。

#en: The moonside relay sits in permanent twilight, a forgotten cargo node clinging to rock and thin atmosphere, built for routine manifests and quiet bribes, not questions. Here is where routes are nudged a little wider, escorts trimmed a ship or two, risk buried under cheap drinks and exhausted clerks who sign off whatever their console prints, then rotate out before the pattern ever sinks in. The broker who worked this desk has already moved on, pockets heavier, conscience light, leaving only one record of the tiny course changes they were paid to process. So far the trail is a dead dataslate in a remote dust patch and whispered talk of altered shipping lanes; this relay's logs are the first proof that those "minor variances" are deliberate, not coincidence.
zh: 那座卫星侧中继处于永久的暮光之中，一个攀附在岩石与稀薄大气上的被遗忘货运节点，为例行舱单与安静的贿赂而建，而不是为了问题。这里正是航线被推宽一点、护航被裁掉一两艘船的地方，风险被埋在廉价酒水与精疲力竭的文书之下——他们照签控制台打印出来的一切，然后在模式沉淀下来之前轮岗离开。在这张桌子前干过的掮客早已转场，口袋更沉、良心更轻，只留下一份记录，记着那些有人付钱让他处理的微小航向改动。目前为止，线索是偏远尘土中一块死掉的数据板与关于被改动航道的低语；这座中继的日志是第一份证据，证明那些"微小差异"是刻意的，而非巧合。

#en: The depot squats at the edge of nowhere, tanks half-drained, consoles running on flicker and habit. It is the kind of place routes pass through, not linger in, which makes the abandoned ledgers and unsent status reports feel louder than the wind howling across the pads. Someone meant to clean this data, balance the tallies, erase the discrepancies, then never came back to finish the job. Buried in those numbers is the pattern of ships steered off their declared paths, the hidden corridors that all point toward the same unseen hand. So far, the trail runs from a nameless dead drop to this forgotten fuel stop, with only a scavenged dataslate and a handful of altered refueling records to prove that something, or someone, has been quietly re-drawing the lanes.
zh: 那座货运站蹲在天涯之外，储罐半空，控制台靠闪烁与惯性运转。这是那种航线只穿过、不停留的地方，正因如此，那些被弃置的账册与未发出的状态报告，听起来比呼啸过停机坪的风还响。有人本打算清理这些数据、平掉账目、抹掉那些差异，然后再没回来完工。埋在这些数字里的，是船只被推离申报路径的模式，是那些全都指向同一只看不见之手的隐藏走廊。目前为止，线索从一处无名死信点，延伸到这座被遗忘的加油站，只有一块捡来的数据板与几份被改动的加油记录，能证明有什么东西、或某个人，一直在悄悄重画航道。

#en: From this hut, the land opens in two directions, each scarred in ways no natural weather should repeat so precisely. The scout's instruments caught twin bands of heated air and scoured rock that mirror each other across the valley, as if someone has been testing parallel approach lanes over the same frontier settlements. Standing among faded Freestar flags and worn sensor rigs, you can read the sky the way a navigator would, see how passing ships would be nudged into one corridor or the other without ever noticing. What started as a single twisted beacon in a frozen lab has become a chain of anomalies, a derelict Navy run cut too close to shear, and now matching wounds in the terrain, all lining up until coincidence is the least convincing explanation left.
zh: 从这座小屋望去，大地朝两个方向铺开，每一侧都以任何自然天气都不该如此精确重复的方式留下伤疤。侦察兵的仪器捕捉到两条被加热的空气带与被刮蚀的岩石，它们在谷地两侧彼此镜像，仿佛有人一直在同一批边境定居点上方测试平行的进近航道。站在褪色的自由星系联盟旗帜与磨损的传感器设备之间，你能像领航员那样解读天空，看出过往船只会如何被推入这一条或那一条走廊、却浑然不觉。起初只是某座冰封实验室里一座扭曲的信标，如今已成一串异常、一次贴近剪切面过近的废弃海军航行，以及现在地形上相互对应的伤口——它们全都排成一线，直到"巧合"成为最没有说服力的解释。

#en: The little scout drifts at the edge of the lane like a smudge someone meant to erase and forgot, its UC markings half-scorched, its transponder still whispering into dead space. If there is anywhere his private geometry would be preserved intact, it is in a Navy hull he once trusted to test new paths, a place no civilian audit would dare pry into. Inside, you can feel the pause in the story, as if some clerk or SysDef handler planned to sweep the logs, file the incident, close the book, and simply never showed up. The trail to this point has been all loose ends and absences: a discarded slate on a backwater rock, a shuttered relay strangled with bad data, and now a military scout where the jump curves finally start to repeat the same quiet, calculated hand.
zh: 那艘小侦察船漂在航道边缘，像一道有人打算抹掉却忘了的污痕，它身上的联殖标识半焦，应答器仍朝死寂太空低语。若说他的私人几何有哪里会被原封不动地保存，那就是一艘他曾信任、用来测试新路径的海军船壳——一个任何民用审计都不敢撬开的地方。里面，你能感觉到故事里的一处停顿，仿佛某个文书或星防队经手人本打算清扫日志、归档事件、合上卷宗，然后就干脆没露面。通往这一步的线索全是松开的线头与缺席：穷乡岩石上一块被丢弃的数据板、一座被坏数据勒住喉咙的关闭中继，以及如今一艘军用侦察船——在这里，跃迁曲线终于开始重复同样那只安静、算计的手。

#en: Out here on the moonside relay, traffic is supposed to be simple: fuel, food, ore, all logged and cleared through a single crooked broker who knows which crates to ignore. That makes this the one place where her trail would condense into numbers and routes, where someone has quietly reconciled stolen medical shipments, missing couriers, and ships that never filed returns. The walls hum with old transmissions, and the dust on half these consoles says nobody asked the right questions for a very long time. So far the line runs from a dead slate on an empty rock, through doctored logs at Gagarin and whispered panic in Neon's back alleys, to this relay where the manifests finally admit how often the same soft-spoken courier passed through without anyone noticing.
zh: 在这座卫星侧中继上，交通本该很简单：燃料、食物、矿石，全部登记、全部经由一名知道该无视哪些货箱的歪斜掮客放行。这让它成了她那条线索唯一会凝聚成数字与航线的地方——在这里，有人悄悄对上了被盗的医疗货运、失踪的信使，以及从未提交报告回执的船只。墙壁因旧传输而嗡鸣，而这一半控制台上的尘土说明，很久没人问过正确的问题了。目前为止，这条线从空岩石上一块死掉的数据板，穿过加加林星被做手脚的日志与霓虹城后巷里压低声音的恐慌，延伸到这座中继——在这里，舱单终于承认：同一名嗓音柔和的信使，多么频繁地在无人注意下经过。
